description: Sleuth Skills connects ChatGPT to your personal skills.new vault — a private collection of skills, rules, agents, and slash commands you've authored or saved. The app lets ChatGPT discover what's in your vault and load the full content of a specific skill on demand, so conversations can follow your own playbooks instead of relying on generic knowledge. It is read-only: it never modifies, deletes, or shares your vault content.
